name: City Hall: Mayor's Office
action_text: Take the first player marker and draw 1 Spin card

name: City Hall: Permits
action_text: Pay the rebuild cost of one resolved crisis you hold and place it on the board as your location

name: Coalition Summit
action_text: Take 1 Coalition Partner. Then you may trade 2 tokens of one type for 1 of another type once

name: Press Room
action_text: Play 1 Spin card. At end of round this exec moves to another open space

name: Newswire
action_text: Draw 1 Spin card. Look at the top 3 crises in the deck and put them back in any order

name: Intern Pool
action_text: Take 2 Analysts. Open to any number of execs
